title: Socratix AI Named a Finalist for the 2026 Money20/20 Money Awards
summary: Socratix AI is one of three finalists in the Startup Early Stage category of the 2026 Money20/20 Money Awards. Winners will be announced October 18 in Las Vegas.
body_markdown:
The Money Awards are Money20/20's global fintech awards program, recognizing the companies, products, and partnerships shaping the future of financial services. Entries are evaluated by an independent panel of industry experts.


This year's finalists span six categories: Startup Early Stage, Startup Growth Stage, Banking, Payments, Partnerships & Strategic Alliance, and Diamond. The list includes early-stage startups, high-growth companies, and established financial institutions from around the world.
